entities.summary: Yana Dmitriyevna Sizikova is a Russian Inactive tennis player who specializes in doubles. She has a career-high doubles ranking by the WTA of 40, achieved on 24 July 2023. She peaked at No. 336 in singles on 20 June 2016.
